card.title: Senior IT Specialist (Robotic Process Automation and AI)

requirements.evidence: Attention to Detail - is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail

Customer Service - Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services

Oral Communication - Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately;
Problem Solving - identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations.

requirements.text: Designing or overseeing large-scale automation efforts using RPA tools such as UiPath, Microsoft Power Automate, or Automation Anywhere
requirements.evidence: You must demonstrate in your resume at least one year (52 weeks) of qualifying specialized experience equivalent to the GS-14 grade level in the Federal government, obtained in either the private or public sector, to include: (1) Designing or overseeing large-scale automation efforts using robotic process automation (RPA) tools such as UiPath, Microsoft Power Automate, or Automation Anywhere.

requirements.text: Analyzing and reviewing automated workflows including integrations between RPA tools and other software applications to assess performance, identify gaps, or recommend improvements
requirements.evidence: (2) Analyzing and reviewing automated workflows, including integrations between RPA tools and other software applications, to assess performance, identify gaps, or recommend improvements.

requirements.text: Planning, scheduling, and carrying out end-to-end RPA projects from business process analysis and bot development through testing, deployment, and performance monitoring
requirements.evidence: (3) Planning, scheduling, and carrying out end-to-end RPA projects (from business process analysis and bot development through testing, deployment, and performance monitoring)

You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.
This job does not have an education qualification requirement.

Summary
This position is located in the Department of Health & Human Services (HHS), Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), Center for Clinical Standards and Quality,CCSQ, Survey and Operations Group (SOG). As a Senior IT Specialist (Robotic Process Automation and AI), GS-2210-15, you will report directly to the SOG Leadership and provide highly complex analysis, project management, and program direction for all Divisions within the Group. Learn more about this agency

Duties
Lead the development, implementation, and maintenance of the Survey and Operations Group's automation strategy
